synthesis.name: related_documents
synthesis.text:
The ingestion ledger records every document hash in Postgres so the worker can reconcile changed files after a restart.
A document hash lets the ledger skip unchanged files without reading their content again.
When a document hash changes the worker retains every chunk of the file with fresh synthesis metadata.
The ledger stores chunk hashes so a removed section can be deleted and tombstoned after the edit.
Postgres leases stop two workers from processing the same ingestion job at the same time.
A retry uses the same stable document id so Hindsight can deduplicate the retained content.
